title: PUNCH
instructions: Put in the rind of three lemons, pour one wineglassful of Jamaica rum, two wineglassfuls of brandy, three tablespoonfuls of loaf sugar, a tumblerful and a half of water ice. Pour on one bottle of champagne.  --MRS. EUGENIA PHILLIPS.
